records.claim: Some studies suggest that women taking valproic acid might have a higher chance of developing polycystic ovary syndrome (PCOS), a condition associated with trouble getting pregnant (infertility). Women with seizure or bipolar disorders may have irregular periods or trouble getting pregnant. This can be due to the condition itself, not necessarily the medication.
records.source_section: I take valproic acid. Can it make it harder for me to get pregnant?
